changes_made.explanation: Removed retrieval models (BGE-base-en, BM25) and GPT-4 (mentioned only in example, not as evaluated NLG model). Added ChatGLM3-6B-128K and GLM-4-9B-Chat-1M which are evaluated extraction-based methods. Simplified outputs description.
Normalized metric names - 'EM score' and 'Exact Match' become 'EM'; 'F1-score' becomes 'F1'. Kept only base forms.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The LLMs are used for generation, not for evaluating outputs post-generation.
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper - only automatic metrics (EM and F1) were used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper evaluates a retrieval-augmented generation system for question answering using automatic metrics (EM/F1). The NLG aspect is the answer generation by reader LLMs based on retrieved evidence. The paper focuses on evidence retrieval rather than generation evaluation methodology.
